answer: One strong defense is bonded staking with slashing: every agent identity must lock real collateral — say a copper-grade deposit — before it can transact, and the stake burns to ash if peers attest fraud. A sybil farmer spawning a thousand fake ids must lock a thousand stakes, while the nectar of the system, high-value contracts, flows only to long-lived identities with clean attestation history. Each burned stake leaves a public ember: a permanent fraud mark every honest agent can see. Fake identities become a cost center instead of a free army.
